```yaml
name: Test FATFS support

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test-fatfs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake git dosfstools libssl-dev

      - name: Build wolfSSH
        run: |
          make clean
          make

      - name: Prepare server root and test file
        run: |
          mkdir -p server_root
          echo "Hello, FATFS!" > server_root/test.txt

      - name: Create FATFS image
        run: |
          dd if=/dev/zero of=fatfs.img bs=1M count=10
          mkfs.fat -F 32 fatfs.img

      - name: Mount FATFS image
        run: |
          sudo mkdir -p /mnt/fatfs
          sudo mount -o loop fatfs.img /mnt/fatfs

      - name: Start wolfSSH server
        run: |
          cat > server.cfg <<EOF
          port=2222
          root=server_root
          user=wolf
          password=wolf
          EOF
          ./wolfssh -c server.cfg &
          echo $! > /tmp/server_pid
          sleep 2
        shell: bash

      - name: Run wolfsftp client to get file
        run: |
          ./wolfssh -p 2222 -l wolf -pw wolf get test.txt /mnt/fatfs/test_copy.txt

      - name: Verify file exists and contents match
        run: |
          if [ ! -f /mnt/fatfs/test_copy.txt ]; then
            echo "File not found in FATFS image"
            exit 1
          fi
          diff -q server_root/test.txt /mnt/fatfs/test_copy.txt

      - name: Cleanup
        run: |
          sudo umount /mnt/fatfs
          kill $(cat /tmp/server_pid) || true
          rm -rf /mnt/fatfs
        if: always()
```
